anchor.semantic_hook: Being in vain is made visible by placing every completed effort inside a hollow container that yields nothing.
anchor.setting: A bare effort-testing hall contains a long workbench, movable equipment bays, and an empty results tray. A room-sized transparent vessel encloses the entire workbench, yet every finished task placed inside vanishes before reaching the results tray. The task-swallowing hollow vessel is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: a room-sized hollow vessel that makes every completed effort vanish

inserts.action: slumps over a night-long pile of completed practice pages, staring in disbelief at a canceled exam kit disappearing inside the hollow vessel

variations.scene_adjust: a desk lamp, an untouched pillow, completed practice pages filled only with geometric diagrams, and a closed exam kit

inserts.action: leans urgently across the workbench toward an empty chair, one palm raised in warning while a car key and her careful argument tokens vanish

variations.scene_adjust: a car key, a miniature car, two facing chairs, and a row of plain discussion tokens

inserts.action: kneels exhausted among opened drawers and overturned cushions, then looks through the vehicle bay toward the keys resting inside the car

variations.scene_adjust: opened drawers, lifted cushions, an emptied coat pocket, and a car in the adjoining vehicle bay with keys on its seat

inserts.action: stands beside a carefully assembled project, protecting it with both arms and gazing reassuringly toward an empty chair while its pieces begin to vanish

variations.scene_adjust: a carefully assembled mechanical project, used tools, and an empty chair facing the workbench

inserts.action: stands drenched beside a fully prepared garden table, shoulders sagging as rain ruins the arrangements inside the vessel

variations.scene_adjust: a garden table, soaked bunting without markings, covered food trays, folded chairs, and heavy rain

inserts.action: waits at the front of the queue rail with aching feet, then throws up both hands at the empty ticket dispenser

variations.scene_adjust: a long queue rail, a clock face without digits, an empty ticket dispenser, and closed service shutters

anchor.semantic_hook: Gambling one's livelihood is staged by putting the objects needed for food, shelter, and work directly onto a game of chance.
anchor.setting: A high-stakes decision room contains a round gaming table, an office bay, and a shelf of household necessities. The tabletop is an immense spinning roulette wheel whose moving pockets hold a loaf of bread, a house key, work tools, and a purse of savings instead of ordinary counters. The livelihood-filled roulette wheel is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: an immense roulette wheel spinning bread, shelter, tools, and savings as stakes

inserts.action: stands between an office chair and the spinning wheel, gripping the chair back while pulling his house key and bread away from the moving pockets

variations.scene_adjust: an office chair, a packed desk box, a house key, and a loaf of bread

inserts.action: leans forward in a heated argument across the office bay, jaw tense and finger raised while his work tools circle the roulette wheel behind him

variations.scene_adjust: two facing office chairs, a pushed-back desk, and a set of work tools caught on the wheel

inserts.action: empties his final savings purse onto one moving pocket and watches the entire stack circle away with a stricken expression

variations.scene_adjust: an empty savings jar, a company model made of plain blocks, and a large stack of coins

inserts.action: stands firmly beside an unused workstation with arms folded, accepting the risk while his bread and house key rotate beyond reach

variations.scene_adjust: an unused workstation, a hard hat set aside, an empty lunch pail, and interlocked raised hands molded from plain wood

inserts.action: turns his back on the spinning wheel and pushes a handful of gaming counters away, relief mixed with alarm as he retrieves his work tools

variations.scene_adjust: discarded gaming counters, an empty counter cup, and work tools being pulled back from the wheel

inserts.action: holds an unsigned contract away from the wheel with both hands, brows furrowed as he examines its blank pages before risking his house key

variations.scene_adjust: an unsigned contract with blank pages, a capped pen, a house key, and a reading lens

anchor.semantic_hook: Getting lost along the way is staged by a road whose own path becomes impossible to follow.
anchor.setting: A city-edge junction contains a paved route, a taxi bay, low buildings, and movable navigation props. The road rises from the ground and ties itself into a colossal three-dimensional knot before splitting back into several lanes. The knotted roadway is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: a roadway tied into a colossal three-dimensional knot

inserts.action: stands at the first split with empty hands and a worried frown, turning from one knotted lane to another without a route map

variations.scene_adjust: an empty map case and several branching lanes

inserts.action: wanders between unfamiliar building models, clutching a house key and peering helplessly at every branch of the knotted road

variations.scene_adjust: unfamiliar apartment facades, a house key, and a small house model placed beyond the junction

inserts.action: leans out from a stopped car shortly after dawn, glaring at a dashboard navigation unit whose arrow points into the wrong branch

variations.scene_adjust: a stopped car, dawn light, and a dashboard navigation unit showing an arrow-only route

inserts.action: walks carefully along one lane, checking each plain arrow board before choosing the route through the knot

variations.scene_adjust: plain directional boards carrying only arrows at each branch

inserts.action: slides anxiously into the rear seat of a waiting taxi and points toward the tangled junction with both brows raised

variations.scene_adjust: a waiting taxi with an unmarked roof lamp and one packed travel bag

inserts.action: stands beside several unattended guest suitcases, checks the empty arrival lane, and lifts both palms in resigned concern

variations.scene_adjust: several guest suitcases, a prepared welcome table, and an empty arrival lane

anchor.setting: A circular planning chamber contains a central pedestal, a curved bench, and movable presentation stands. Every chair, document tray, and discussion prop floats in a single continuous orbit around the pedestal. The orbiting room furnishings are the only surreal element.

inserts.action: stands at the curved bench and tracks the orbiting coin columns with a focused expression, keeping both hands directed toward the central budget model

variations.scene_adjust: a school desk, plain notebooks, pencils, a globe, and two opposing debate benches

inserts.action: stands beside the curved bench with one arm extended toward the central sun sphere, watching planet models travel around it

variations.scene_adjust: a glowing sun sphere on the central pedestal and planet models arranged along the circular path

anchor.semantic_hook: Doing something by oneself is staged by isolating the task and its doer from every source of help.
anchor.setting: A self-reliance workshop contains a task platform surrounded by supply cabinets, tool racks, and assistance stations. A vast circular moat opens inside the room, leaving the platform alone at its center while every helpful resource remains across the gap. The indoor moat isolating the task platform is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: a vast indoor moat separating the task platform from every source of help

inserts.action: sits at one small desk on the isolated platform, stumped by a geometric puzzle and reaching unsuccessfully toward the distant assistance station
sits at a second small desk with an equally puzzled expression, raising one hand toward the help waiting across the moat

variations.scene_adjust: two small school desks, a geometric puzzle, pencils, and a help kit across the moat

inserts.action: kneels beside a dormant computer on the isolated platform and stretches toward the configuration knobs on the far bank

variations.scene_adjust: a dormant computer with blank interface tiles and a separate bank of configuration knobs

inserts.action: holds several empty speech-shaped tokens at her chest, visibly overwhelmed as the remaining emotions stay beyond their capacity

variations.scene_adjust: empty speech-shaped tokens and an overflowing box of varied emotion masks

variations.scene_adjust: unfinished table settings, bundled decorations without markings, stacked chairs, and several empty team stations

inserts.action: sits wearily on a suitcase at the isolated platform's edge, massaging one tired ankle and reaching toward the distant travel assistance cart

variations.scene_adjust: two suitcases, two walking canes, travel pillows, and an assistance cart across the moat

anchor.semantic_hook: Meeting something head-on is staged by forcing both sides onto one direct front-to-front axis with no sideways route.
anchor.setting: A long confrontation corridor contains two opposing position pads, a vehicle bay, and a straight central track. The track continues up the front wall in one impossible unbroken line, eliminating every turn or detour while keeping both ends directly opposed. The wall-climbing straight track is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: a perfectly straight confrontation track that climbs the front wall without bending

inserts.action: stands squarely on one position pad with open hands and a firm expression, speaking directly across the central track
faces him from the opposite pad, listening intently while keeping her back turned away from an unused rear conversation chair

variations.scene_adjust: two opposing conversation chairs and one unused chair behind the listening position

inserts.action: braces behind the wheel of a red car at one end of the track, eyes wide and both hands rigid before the head-on impact

variations.scene_adjust: a red car and a truck aligned nose to nose on a highway strip in the vehicle bay

inserts.action: plants his feet on the central track and presses both hands against a dense tangle of ropes, gears, and pipes blocking the way

variations.scene_adjust: a dense tangle of ordinary ropes, gears, and pipes blocking the central track

inserts.action: stands on one pad with a questioning palm raised, holding steady eye contact across the track
looks straight back from the opposing pad and gives one clear affirmative nod

variations.scene_adjust: two bare opposing position pads with no intervening props

inserts.action: leans forward into a fierce wind on the central track, coat pressed backward and forearm shielding his face
struggles directly beside him, head lowered and both hands gripping her wind-whipped coat

variations.scene_adjust: loose leaves and dust blowing directly along the track toward both walkers

inserts.action: stands directly opposite her with a candid questioning expression, one hand extended toward a waiting work chair
faces him without turning away, considering the offer with arms loosely folded

variations.scene_adjust: a work chair, a plain desk, and a tool case placed between the opposing pads

anchor.semantic_hook: Getting under the skin is made visible by trapping the source of a feeling beneath a physical skin membrane.
anchor.setting: A sensory gallery contains a low examination platform, movable media stands, and an empty reaction chair. An immense translucent skin membrane stretches across the room, with incoming objects visibly lodged beneath its surface and impossible to shake loose. The room-spanning skin membrane is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: an immense translucent skin membrane trapping every emotional trigger beneath its surface

inserts.action: sits absorbed in the reaction chair with eyes closed and one hand over her chest while beautiful musical shapes settle beneath the membrane

variations.scene_adjust: a music player with simple control icons, headphones, and flowing musical-note shapes

variations.scene_adjust: pointed empty critique tokens, a small shield, and a second empty reaction chair

variations.scene_adjust: a sharp empty speech token bouncing away and several previously trapped tokens

anchor.semantic_hook: Being out of control is staged by placing every unruly subject physically beyond the reach of its control mechanism.
anchor.setting: An emergency operations hall contains a central console, equipment bays, and a circular control boundary. A colossal control lever has torn free from the console and floats beyond the room's outer wall, leaving everything inside unreachable and unmanaged. The displaced colossal control lever is the only surreal element.

anchor.semantic_hook: Giving activities over as concluded is staged by passing their final piece through a closing threshold into a finished bay.

A room-sized stone hand reaches from the threshold and carries each final task piece into the sealed bay before drawing the door shut. The task-carrying stone hand is the only surreal element.

anchor.semantic_hook: A shrinking heart is made visible by reducing a large physical heart to a tiny form at the instant sadness arrives.
anchor.setting: An empathy chamber contains a central examination platform, a curved viewing bench, and movable memory displays. anchor.semantic_hook: Removing importance is staged by physically taking weight away from a serious matter until it appears deceptively light.
